about_the_game:
✨ Welcome to Craft & Deliver! ✨
Have you ever dreamed of building your own cozy workshop from scratch? Now you can! In this relaxing simulation game, you’ll gather materials, craft unique wooden creations, and deliver them straight to your happy customers.

🪚 Craft, Build, Deliver!

Your journey begins with nothing but a few simple tools. Step by step, you’ll design, cut, polish, and bring wooden creations to life. Every order is different, and each satisfied customer gets you closer to becoming a true master artisan.

🌱 Relaxing & Cozy Gameplay

No rush, no pressure — just you, your workshop, and the joy of creation. Upgrade your tools, expand your space, decorate your workshop, and watch it grow into a vibrant place full of charm and creativity.

🚚 The Thrill of Delivery

What’s more satisfying than crafting a unique item? Delivering it right on time! Each delivery challenges you with timing and preparation, bringing just the right pinch of excitement to your cozy routine.

💡 Why you’ll love Craft & Deliver

  • A wholesome, cozy atmosphere 🌿

  • Relaxing gameplay with rewarding progression

  • Woodworking, creativity, and light management all in one

  • Satisfying loop: Collect → Craft → Deliver → Upgrade

    Craft & Deliver     is the perfect mix of relaxing vibes and hands-on fun. Whether you’re a fan of cozy sims, woodworking, or just want a game that makes you smile after a long day — this one’s for you!
